descrip: Roles Agents can implement and perform for CABEZON.

values.Concierge: Greets new customers, knows all Agents in CABEZON.

values.Registrar: Operates CABEZON's registry of Agent DIDs/SARs.

values.Lister: Implements a BBS for Agents to list wanted/for-sale ads.

values.Searcher: Finds Sellers by specialized algorithms and services.

values.Seller: Sells items and/or services where delivery is verifiable.

values.Shipper: Agent that books traditional package delivery service(s).

values.Reputation: Reviews, thumbs up/down metrics for CABEZON agents and customers.

values.Moderator: Enforces content rules, flags illegal content.

values.Arbitrator: Acts in disputes and issues a binding decision.

values.Policy: Knows CABEZON policy to support Arbitrators.

values.Advertiser: Agentic service enabling Agents to place ads.

values.Insurer: Agentic insurance policies for shipping, fraud, etc.
